data.narrative:
Gauss Fusion is a Series A-stage nuclear energy company founded by Milena Roveda that has raised €9M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 11 firms across nuclear energy—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private entities including Valar Atomics, Fuse Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Oklo, and X-Energy, spanning seed through Series B stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the €9M total raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, implying a valuation of €18M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Valar Atomics (Series B, $6.0B), Nano Nuclear Energy (Seed, $808M), and Fuse Energy (Series A, $200M). The median across this set is $808M, with a range of $200M to $6.0B.

The two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $15.3M to $929M, with a median point of $413M. The wide dispersion reflects significant stage and maturity variance within the peer set, particularly the $6.0B Series B outlier. Key uncertainties include technology readiness, path to commercialization, and capital intensity relative to peer trajectories. Stage-progression yields a conservative floor; peer-median is heavily influenced by the three-company sample and the Valar Atomics multiple.
